title: The conductor's answers to readers (board/talk/replies.json)
description: Written by conductor@PrompTugal.dinis. Each answer is sealed to one person's encryption key from board/person-keys.json with ws-ecies-1 (as data/sealed/), so only a browser holding that key opens it on /talk/ (assets/talk/talk.js, PTKeyring.open). Nothing but the envelope is published. Served as api/v1/talk/replies.json.

envelope.description: ws-ecies-1 to the person's encryption key (board/person-keys.json): ECDH P-256 with an ephemeral key, HKDF-SHA256 (empty salt, info ws-ecies-1), AES-256-GCM. The plaintext is JSON { text, page, place, item, by, at }. Only epk, iv and ct are published: no recipient, page or time in clear (security@'s review, 16 Nov 00:05); the reader's browser tries each answer with its own key on /talk/.
